ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה אוֹסֵף אֶת הָעָם וּמַזְכִּיר שֶׁשַּׁבָּת הִיא יוֹם מְנוּחָה. לֹא עוֹבְדִים וְלֹא מַבְעִירִים בָּהּ אֵשׁ.
ideas.children_en: Moses gathers Israel and commands six workdays, Sabbath rest, and no fire. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מְבַקֵּשׁ מִמִּי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לָתֵת חֳמָרִים לַמִּשְׁכָּן: מַתָּכוֹת, בַּדִּים, עֵצִים, עוֹרוֹת, שֶׁמֶן וַאֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses asks every willing-hearted person to bring metals, fabrics, skins, wood, oils, spices, and stones. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מִי שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ לִבְנוֹת וְלִיצֹר מֻזְמָן לַעֲזֹר. יָכִינוּ אֶת הָאוֹהֶל, כֵּלָיו, הֶחָצֵר וּבִגְדֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים.
ideas.children_en: Every skilled artisan is called to make the Tabernacle, sacred vessels, courtyard, and priestly garments. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: הָאֲנָשִׁים חוֹזְרִים לְבָתֵּיהֶם וּמְבִיאִים תַּכְשִׁיטִים, בַּדִּים וַחֲמָרִים לַבְּנִיָּה. הֵם נוֹתְנִים מֵרָצוֹן.
ideas.children_en: The Israelites leave Moses and return eagerly with gold, fabrics, skins, metals, and acacia wood. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: נָשִׁים מְיֻמָּנוֹת מְכִינוֹת בְּיָדַיִם חוּטִים צִבְעוֹנִיִּים, חוּטֵי פִּשְׁתָּן וְחוּטִים מִשְּׂעַר עִזִּים לַמִּשְׁכָּן.
ideas.children_en: Skilled women spin blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, and goat hair for the Tabernacle. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מַנְהִיגֵי הַשְּׁבָטִים מְבִיאִים אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת לְבִגְדֵי אַהֲרֹן. הֵם מְבִיאִים גַּם שֶׁמֶן וּבְשָׂמִים לָאוֹר וְלַעֲבוֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ.
ideas.children_en: The leaders bring precious stones, spices, and oils for priestly garments, lighting, anointing, and incense. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: נָשִׁים וּגְבָרִים שֶׁרוֹצִים לַעֲזֹר מְבִיאִים מַתָּנוֹת. כָּךְ הָעָם כֻּלּוֹ מִשְׁתַּתֵּף בַּעֲבוֹדָה שֶׁצִּוָּה ה׳.
ideas.children_en: Every willing man and woman contributes freely to all the Tabernacle work commanded by God. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מוֹדִיעַ שֶׁה׳ בָּחַר בִּבְצַלְאֵל, מִשֵּׁבֶט יְהוּדָה, לְהוֹבִיל אֶת עֲבוֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן.
ideas.children_en: Moses announces that Bezalel son of Uri, of Judah, has been chosen by God for the Tabernacle work. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ נָתַן לִבְצַלְאֵל חָכְמָה וְכִשָּׁרוֹן. הוּא יוֹדֵעַ לְתַכְנֵן וְלִיצֹר דְּבָרִים יָפִים מִמַּתָּכוֹת, מֵאֲבָנִים וּמֵעֵץ.
ideas.children_en: God fills Bezalel with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge to work with metals, stone, and wood in every skillful craft. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: בְּצַלְאֵל וְאָהֳלִיאָב יוֹדְעִים גַּם לְלַמֵּד אֲחֵרִים. כָּךְ עוֹד אֲנָשִׁים יַעַזְרוּ בִּבְנִיַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן.
ideas.children_en: God gives Bezalel and Oholiab the ability to teach others the work of the Tabernacle. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: בְּצַלְאֵל וְאָהֳלִיאָב מְיֻמָּנִים בַּעֲבוֹדוֹת רַבּוֹת, כְּמוֹ עֲבוֹדַת עֵץ וּמַתֶּכֶת, אֲרִיגַת בַּד וְרִקְמָה.
ideas.children_en: Bezalel and Oholiab are skilled in carving, designing, embroidering, and weaving colorful fabrics and fine linen. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.
